# Show Off — Portable Fallback

Use when the user wants a demo/showcase/presentation page rather than ordinary documentation.

## Inputs

Gather:
- what work should be demonstrated;
- intended audience;
- real screenshots/assets/results;
- established presentation preferences/brand system when available;
- privacy constraints.

Do not require the user to restate preferences already available in scoped Context/Memory.

## Workflow

1. Reconcile the completed work/artifacts that actually exist.
2. Select the most persuasive real evidence: screenshots, diagrams, metrics or interactive demo elements.
3. Capture missing visuals through the available browser/rendering path when appropriate.
4. Build a self-contained HTML showcase with clear narrative hierarchy.
5. Keep interactions purposeful and avoid fake dashboards/metrics.
6. Avoid external dependencies when a self-contained artifact is requested.
7. Preview at representative viewport sizes.
8. Verify private data, tokens and internal URLs are not accidentally exposed.

## Boundary

The showcase presents verified work; it does not upgrade incomplete implementation into “done”.

If no browser/HTML preview is available, deliver the artifact and state the visual-verification gap.
